titre: Exchange Exit Kit: a step-by-step self-custody wizard and exchange-risk dashboard after the $6.3bn Binance hack
pitch: Binance users pulled $3.64bn within hours of withdrawals reopening. A neutral, multilingual wizard that walks them from 'my coins sit on an exchange' to 'I safely hold my own keys', funded by hardware-wallet affiliate commissions.
